triples.head_surface: Cooling water supply to the refrigerating plant
triples.evidence_text: Cooling water supply to the refrigerating plant (where required) is to be provided from at least two circulating pumps one of which being used as a stand-by.

triples.head_surface: Cooling water supply to the refrigerating plant
triples.tail_surface: taken from not less than two sea connections
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 取自不少于两个海水接口
triples.evidence_text: Cooling water is to be taken from not less than two sea connections, preferably one port and one starboard.

triples.tail_surface: piping classes to be determined in accordance with in 4-6-1/5
triples.evidence_text: Pipes, fittings, and pipe joints are to be designed, fabricated and tested, and to be of materials according to the piping classes to be determined in accordance with in 4-6-1/5.

triples.tail_surface: buildup of pressure in excess of the design pressure
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 压力积聚超过设计压力
triples.evidence_text: Safety relief devices are to be provided in each section of pipe that may be isolated by block valves and in which there could be a buildup of pressure in excess of the design pressure of any of the components.
